root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: alteration in color or appearance, and a share, portion, or allotted object.
root_idea.development: The share-and-portion branch extends to drawing lots, the arrow as one item among allotted arrows, kinship as a share of connected lineage, and striped markings likened to arrows. The color-change branch includes heat effects, emaciation, altered complexion, and related conditions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form III verb is a distinct public form and is supported by direct lexical evidence for drawing lots.

senses.definition: To cast or draw lots with others, originally by competing with arrows in sortilege; in the Quranic construction, to draw lots with the people of a ship, with the contest yielding a defeated party.
senses.usage_conditions: A competitive lot-drawing construction; the object or participants may be expressed or understood from context. The Quranic occurrence describes Jonah's lot-drawing contest with the ship's people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become altered in color or complexion, or lean and lank in the belly; to be affected by scorching heat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or, by extension, of a face or other affected subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The making of a garment marked with stripes or lines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The stripes are likened to arrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shoot arrows with someone in competition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the arrow-shooting use of Form III, distinct from drawing lots.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To share or participate with someone in a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The shared matter may be introduced with فِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with someone for a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form III competitive construction; the attestation is presented as approximate in the lexical source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arrange, order, or cause people to cast lots among themselves, or to cast lots among them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is causative or facilitative: the subject organizes the lot-drawing or makes it take place among the participants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a lot, share, or portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recipient is introduced with لِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become loquacious or profuse in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct lexical use, treated as synonymous with أَسْهَبَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To share together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI expresses mutual participation or sharing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with one another for a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A mutual competitive use distinct from simple sharing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cast or draw lots with one another, or to practise sortilege.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Synonymous with mutual lot-drawing expressions formed from قَرَعَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow or missile fitted with an iron head and feathers; also, in an astronomical application, the Arrow constellation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also denote the arrow used for casting lots or for a game of hazard, including a featherless or headless lot-drawing arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thing won by the person whose arrow succeeds in a game of lot-casting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized extension from the successful gaming arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lot, share, or portion of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense applies broadly to an allotted portion, including a share of spoil or property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mast of a ship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation based on resemblance to an arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The beam of a house or chamber.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional architectural use based on resemblance to an arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure of six cubits used in measuring land for sales and purchases.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized unit of measurement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone placed over the entrance of a chamber used to trap a lion, falling into place and closing the entrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This sense is separately reported in the lexical tradition and may also be written with ش in some accounts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fine, filmy substance called gossamer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the definite article in the reported expressions; it is also described figuratively as the spun thread of sun-rays or the snivel of the devil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Overpowering heat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun distinct in vocalization from the arrow and share senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intelligent, knowledgeable, skilful, judicious, or capable working men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural designation for capable workers; a parallel form with ش is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relationship or kinship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The associated expression ذُو السُّهْمَةِ means a relation or kinsman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heat of the samum wind, the burning heat of summer, or the dust clouds raised by it; also a hot wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as either singular or plural for a hot wind or its effects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leanness or lankness in the belly, altered complexion, and dryness of the lips.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A condition or visible effect of wasting and heat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease affecting camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A named camel ailment, distinct from the general symptoms of leanness and altered color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eagle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description “flying” is explicative rather than an additional lexical restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A frown or anxious contraction of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is associated with anxiety or distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A maker of arrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun formed from the arrow sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having an altered face or complexion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The phrase is applied to a person and describes the visible effect of difficulty or distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Driven to perform an exhausting or distressing exertion, especially of running or battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a horse or to a person compelled to strenuous action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lean or lank in the belly, applied to a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific feminine participial application in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Camels altered or worn by journeying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural form describing the effects of travel on camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A half-blooded horse or stallion-camel, descended from a high-bred sire and a lower-bred dam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In a poetic figurative application, the image describes an unsuitable or unequal marriage partner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wasting away in body through love, or losing one's reason.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person whose body or rational faculties are declining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loquacious or profuse in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant formation related in meaning to مُسْهَبٌ or مُسْهِبٌ, with م reported in place of ب.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment marked with stripes or lines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially a striped garment of the type called بُرْد; the markings are likened to arrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lean or lank in the belly, or affected by scorching heat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person in the reported adjectival construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smitten with the disease called سُهَام, applied to a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of a camel affected by the named disease.

cautions: The Quranic Form III occurrence is specifically the lot-drawing construction; the ordinary noun meanings of arrow and share are broader Classical Arabic branches and are not being assigned to that Quranic form.
The Quranic location 37:141 is supplied by QAC; the historical citation in the lexical evidence is not independently converted into a modern location.
